title: Tata Power Company Ltd — Press Release
text: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated September 03, 2026, titled "Press release titled Tata Power Strengthens NCR s Power Infrastructure with Commissioning of 400kV Jalpura-Khurja Transmission Corridor, comprising 162 CKM Transmission lines and 1,000 MVA Substation .".
